newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis says cooperating with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis says cooperating with SEC.

text.p: Green Oasis Environmental Inc said it believes heavy traffic on the Internet about the company may have led to the Securities and Exchange Commission's decision to suspend trading in the company's stock.
The company said it was surprised that the SEC halted trading in it on May 9. The halt is in effect until May 22.
Green Oasis said it has been cooperating with an informal investigation being conducted by the SEC's Atlanta office and was given no notice or warning about the trade halt.

"We believe that heavy Internet traffic concerning the company, similar to the traffic concerning another company which failed, may have precipitated the SEC's decision," President William Carraway said in a statement.
The SEC had said it halted trading "because of questions that have been raised about the accuracy and adequacy of publicly disseminated information."
Green Oasis is involved in developing and selling equipment to process waste motor oil into more valuable fuel.
